en.title: A Buddhist Heritage Route in China
en.headline: China's Buddhist Heritage: Connect Caves, Temples and Living Practice
en.description: Build one focused Buddhist heritage module by contrasting cave patronage, sacred landscape and living religious practice instead of collecting distant monuments.
en.heroAlt: Buddhist carvings in the Longmen Grottoes beside the Yi River in Luoyang

zh.heroAlt: 洛阳龙门石窟中的佛教造像与河岸
